name: wiki-guides-adopt-pages
description: Adopt with hand-made pages (scripted; R21): three guides with their pictures and no guides.json, and the same guides already on the mock wiki as hand-made pages. /user-guides:wiki-guides adopt registers the guides written and their images taken (no shot invented, no file changed), then, with the go-ahead, updates the hand-made pages in place by id after one confirmation.
prompt: /user-guides:wiki-guides adopt adoptFiles={{files}} adoptTitles=as-written adoptTree=flat destination=confluence guides=all under={{under}} release=1.0 go-ahead=yes
